goal: Elevar o CVG Diagnostics Hub localmente para uma candidata State of Art / Triple AAA sem inventar autoridade clínica, operacional ou de release.

verdict_model.rule: A condição local automatizada não fecha critérios que dependem de ambiente, autoridade humana, aceite clínico ou revisão independente.

sources.location: User request and attached implementation brief
sources.license_notes: Authority limited to scoped local implementation; no production or external publication authority is implied.
Repository plan is normative for local scope and explicitly preserves human gates.
Backlog status is not evidence of completion.
Local framework guidance read before code changes.

criteria.target: Current artifact, instructions, dirty-tree boundaries, requirements, evidence freshness and blockers are reconciled before each material implementation slice.
criteria.evidence_method: Current state checkpoint, git diff/status, source inspection and evidence manifest bound to the candidate.

baseline.actual: Recovery performed; repository is intentionally dirty with preserved user/previous-agent work; candidate fingerprint and evidence manifest are bound after the current run.

criteria.conditions: No historical packet is accepted as current without a current-tree check.
criteria.validity_notes: Prevents implementation and verification from using stale claims or overwriting unrelated work.

criteria.target: Every patient, request, item, result, attachment, timeline, queue, search, SSE and command boundary enforces actor/action/resource/condition server-side with fail-closed negative cases.
criteria.evidence_method: Authorization unit/API/E2E tests plus known-bad mutation controls and independent read-only review.

baseline.actual: Local matrix exists; institutional identity and independent target review remain open.

criteria.conditions: Hospital identity, delegated authority and target IdP remain human/environment gates.
criteria.validity_notes: UI visibility cannot prove resource authorization; negative boundary tests are required.

criteria.target: PRD/SPEC/OpenAPI/Zod/runtime/UI agree on operation paths, payloads, status codes, errors, pagination, idempotency, and realtime semantics.
criteria.evidence_method: OpenAPI validator, runtime contract tests, traceability validator, route tests and clean build/typecheck.

baseline.actual: Current local documentation, OpenAPI and type/lint checks pass; full candidate evidence is revalidated after the current changes.

criteria.conditions: External consumers and remote CI remain unverified until executed.
criteria.validity_notes: A source-only type check does not prove runtime response semantics, so boundary tests are required.

criteria.target: Migrations, relational projection, backfill, replay, constraints, reconciliation and recovery preserve lineage and do not silently replace JSONB authority before approved cutover.
criteria.evidence_method: Disposable PostgreSQL integration tests, populated migration/backfill/reconciliation manifests, explain plans, restore and cutover gate.

baseline.actual: Relational sample-lineage seam exists, but current authority remains JSONB and target/cutover evidence is unavailable.

criteria.conditions: D-01/D-05 and a disposable or target PostgreSQL runtime are required for later stages.
criteria.license_notes: No production database mutation is authorized by this bar.
criteria.validity_notes: Empty-cluster tests cannot prove legacy-data safety or cutover correctness.

criteria.target: Identity/context, Lab, RX, US, sample/recollection, result/review/amend/void and critical-result behavior are coherent across domain, API, UI and audit without invented policy.
criteria.evidence_method: Policy-bound unit/API/browser journeys, negative and concurrent cases, audit assertions and clinical review.

baseline.actual: Laboratory synthetic slice exists; complete clinical policy and hospital acceptance are unavailable.

criteria.conditions: D-01..D-04 and clinical owners must approve semantics before closure.
criteria.license_notes: No clinical policy is inferred from fixtures.
criteria.validity_notes: Synthetic fixtures cannot establish that clinical semantics are institutionally safe.

criteria.target: Two instances, sessions, rate limiting, SSE, replay, outbox, storage/AV, observability, load, failover and recovery have explicit degraded behavior and measurable limits.
criteria.evidence_method: Production-like local packet plus target deployment, resource/load/soak, chaos, alert and restore drills.

baseline.actual: Local cross-process evidence exists; target infrastructure, representative workload and recovery remain unavailable.

criteria.conditions: D-05 and target SRE infrastructure are required.
criteria.license_notes: No deployment or external service mutation is authorized.
criteria.validity_notes: Local process pairs do not prove target topology, capacity or failure recovery.

criteria.target: The primary clinical workspace preserves hierarchy, truth, state cues, keyboard/focus, touch, zoom/reflow, reduced motion, readable density and required content at 375/768/1440 and relevant states.
criteria.evidence_method: Native browser captures, interaction/accessibility packet, visual ledger, fresh read-only critic and manual review where applicable.

baseline.actual: Local state matrix exists; manual screen-reader/touch/product-golden review is not complete.

criteria.conditions: A local render cannot be called AAA without current independent and manual evidence.
criteria.license_notes: AAA visual claims require observed renders.
criteria.validity_notes: Source scans and automated browser checks cannot establish semantic visual quality or manual accessibility.

criteria.target: Current code has risk-shaped unit/component/API/integration/browser/security/performance/recovery checks, valid negative controls, no untracked test regressions, and current evidence manifests.
criteria.evidence_method: Typecheck, lint, coverage, build, E2E/accessibility, PostgreSQL where available, performance, recovery, security, migration, docs and traceability commands.

baseline.actual: Focused and browser regressions pass after implementation; the complete candidate suite and fresh manifest remain the closing evidence.

criteria.conditions: Unavailable environments remain NOT_RUN/BLOCKED and cannot be averaged away.
criteria.validity_notes: A green build alone does not exercise auth, persistence, browser behavior or recovery.

criteria.target: Next.js 16 conventions, Node pin, dependency/audit policy, module boundaries, secrets handling, generated contracts and source-of-truth ownership remain coherent and maintainable.
criteria.evidence_method: Next version-matched docs, type/lint/build, architecture fitness, npm audit, secret scan, diff inspection and clean-checkout CI.

baseline.actual: Next 16.3.0 guidance was read; Node 22.23.2 clean npm ci/validate/build and local architecture, full audit and dependency checks pass; remote CI remains pending.

criteria.license_notes: No package upgrade is implied by this criterion.
criteria.validity_notes: Framework correctness and source ownership reduce hidden runtime and supply-chain regressions.

criteria.target: Every material MUST/AC maps to requirement, implementation, test/procedure, current evidence, owner, limitation and revalidation trigger; stale counts are eliminated.
criteria.evidence_method: Traceability/docs validators, current status report, evidence manifests and independent documentation review.

baseline.actual: Current docs, traceability and evidence validators pass; plan/backlog status and run evidence are explicitly reconciled, with independent review and human ownership still pending.

criteria.conditions: Human ownership and authority records are required for release claims.
criteria.validity_notes: Traceability prevents undocumented claims but does not replace observed behavior.

criteria.target: Training, support, stop criteria, pilot, rollback/roll-forward and formal release decision are executed and recorded by authorized people in the target environment.
criteria.evidence_method: Signed decision records, operator-run drills, pilot telemetry, incident review and release gate.

baseline.actual: No hospital pilot or formal release authority is available in the local workspace.

criteria.conditions: This criterion cannot be closed by code, tests or an agent.
criteria.validity_notes: A clinical system is not release-ready without a controlled operational acceptance decision.

revision_log.change: Canonicalized AAA-3 verdict fields, downgraded locally green criteria to VERIFY while conditions remain open, and added the explicit AAA-2 (AAA-01..AAA-22) crosswalk.
revision_log.reason: Prevent legacy criterion IDs and local passes from being interpreted as release authority.

revision_log.change: Reauthorized current actor/resource scope before every application idempotency replay path and added focused revocation regressions for workflow and result commands.
revision_log.reason: Prevent cached command responses from bypassing a permission or delegated-service change after the original commit.
